title: API crashes after a deploy
reason: The diagnosis correctly identifies the API component, the missing package due to the new deploy, and the deploy as the trigger.
root_cause: The API container crashes on start‑up because the newly deployed image shopapp/api:2.3.2 is missing the pydantic-settings Python package, causing a ModuleNotFoundError. Nginx receives no backend replies and returns 502 Bad Gateway to users.
truth: api 2.3.2 imports the pydantic_settings library, but it isn't installed in the image, so the app crashes on start (exit code 1) and Docker keeps restarting it.
